description:
Sole_Warrior

Sole_Warrior is a team led and maintained by Farhana Akter, a developer and cybersecurity enthusiast passionate about technology and problem-solving.

I'm excited to participate in the NASA International Space Apps Challenge — an opportunity to explore new ideas, challenge myself, learn from the experience, and contribute to something meaningful.

I don't know what the final outcome will be, but I'm ready to take on the challenge, learn along the way...
summary: When extreme disasters strike, optical satellites go blind under storm clouds and midnight darkness. SOLEWARRIOR harnesses active microwave Synthetic Aperture Radar (NASA-ISRO NISAR & Copernicus Sentinel-1) to pierce through cloud covers and darkness with 100% all-weather visibility, tracking flood inundations and millimeter-scale ground displacement to safeguard vulnerable communities worldwide.
details:
Sole_Warrior is an authentic, cloud-native Earth Observation and disaster intelligence application built to make Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) accessible to humanitarian teams, civil protection agencies, and researchers.

Core Capabilities:

1. All-Weather Cloud Penetration Engine: Models how microwave wavelengths (24 cm L-Band and 5.6 cm C-Band) pass freely through dense storm clouds and operate without sunlight.

2. Synchronized Optical vs. SAR Dual-Map Slider: Emergency responders can drag a split divider to see cloudy, unusable optical imagery on one side and crisp, specular flood footprints on the other.

3. Millimeter InSAR Interferometry: Processes repeat-pass phase interferograms to visualize crustal displacement fringes (where 1 rainbow cycle = 2.8 cm displacement) for volcanic bulging and urban subsidence.

4. Disaster Analytics Dashboard: Computes real-time hectares flooded, radar backscatter sensitivity (sigma naught in dB), and exposed population counts.

5. Multi-Hazard Regimes: Pre-configured study zones across 5 planetary hazards: Sylhet Monsoon Flood (Bangladesh), Grindavík Volcanic Uplift (Iceland), Jakarta Land Subsidence (Indonesia), Amazon Deforestation (Brazil), and Valencia DANA Flash Flood (Spain).

Benefits & Humanitarian Impact:

- Zero Weather Delay: Responders no longer need to wait days for storm clouds to clear to map levee breaches and submerged villages.

- Actionable Evacuation Guidance: Inundation masks identify safe dry ridges and passable roads for boat rescues.

- Early Warning for Geohazards: Sub-centimeter magma swelling detection enables proactive evacuations before volcanic eruptions or structural infrastructure collapses.

- Educational Democratization: With interactive character guides (Nova & SAR-E) and an interactive "Why SAR?" science primer, complex microwave physics is translated into clear, human-understandable visual stories.

Technology Stack & Engineering:

- Frontend Framework: React 19, Vite, JavaScript (ESNext).

- Geospatial & Visualization: Leaflet.js, React-Leaflet, Lucide Vector Architecture.

- Audio Synthesis: Web Audio API (real-time 4-note ascending synthesizer arpeggio) & Web Speech Synthesis API.

- Styling & Responsiveness: Vanilla CSS with custom glassmorphism, responsive split-views, and CSS clamp typography.

- Cloud & Hosting: Vercel (Edge CDN with SPA route rewrites for deep-linking).

- Version Control: Git & GitHub.

Creativity & Key Considerations:

- Interactive Narrative Approach: Rather than presenting raw, impenetrable GIS files, Sole_Warrior frames SAR through an interactive 5-Act planetary story accompanied by Nova, a spacewalking astronaut guide who reacts to touch with child-like audio modulations.

- Scientific Rigor Pledge: We prioritized authentic scientific validity—integrating genuine satellite wavelengths, polarizations (VV/VH), and real coordinates rather than generic mockups.

- Universal Accessibility: Engineered a fluid, responsive UI designed to function reliably on field tablets, laptops, and mobile screens without horizontal clipping or excessive scrolling.
